name: fix-express-channel-preflight-docstring-drift
title: Correct the REVIEW preflight express-channel docstrings (codex-adapter is not forced-pass; gate count stale)
description: The same combination review that found B-f882 also found a documentation-vs-behavior drift (finding #2) in packages/main/src/handlers/review-preflight.ts. Three comments claim the express channel forces ALL CLI gates to pass: line ~19-20 ('Express channel ... skips entirely — all CLI gates treated as pass'), line ~122 ('true if fast-channel story — all 4 gates forced-pass'), and line ~224 ('Express channel → all four gates forced-pass (channel/concept/lint/docs-drift not actually run)'). The actual express branch (runReviewCliGates, ~lines 232-282) force-skips FIVE gates (channel, concept, lint, docs-drift, english-artifacts) but then CONDITIONALLY evaluates the codex-adapter gate for real: when storyRequiresCodexEvidence is true it pushes a codex-adapter entry with ok = (codex.status === 'passing'), and the function returns gates.every(g => g.ok) — so an express-channel story CAN still be blocked by a failing codex-adapter gate. The docstrings are therefore wrong on two counts: (1) they say 'all gates forced-pass' but codex-adapter is not forced-pass (it is conditionally evaluated and can block), and (2) they say 'four gates' / 'all 4 gates' but there are now six (channel/concept/lint/docs-drift/english-artifacts/codex-adapter). This is pure comment/doc drift — no behavior change — but it will mislead an operator who reads 'express = all gates skipped' and is then surprised by a codex-adapter block. Outcome: rewrite the three comments to state accurately that express channel force-skips channel/concept/lint/docs-drift/english-artifacts, while the codex-adapter gate is still conditionally evaluated (when the story touches Codex adapter assets) and can block; and correct the stale gate count. This is a comments-only change — do NOT modify any gate logic, the express branch behavior, or any other code. EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE: the english-artifacts metadata-root mismatch (finding #3, deferred by the user) — do not touch it.
